_schema: AN EMPTY ALLOWLIST IS THE GOAL STATE. Every entry here is a box or a rule
that the census would otherwise fail on: a droplet behind no cloud firewall,
or a firewall that allows :22 from the whole internet. Adding one does not
make the exposure safe -- it records that a human looked, decided to accept it
for now, and named the issue that will close it.
id       DO droplet id (number) or firewall id (uuid string) -- the stable key
name     live name at time of writing; a mismatch is reported, not fatal
issue    GOL-NNNN tracking the fix. Enforced by regex; no issue, no exemption.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. PAST THIS DATE THE ENTRY STOPS SUPPRESSING AND BECOMES
A FINDING ITSELF, so a 'temporary' exposure cannot quietly become
permanent by nobody re-reading this file.
why      one line a reviewer can judge without opening the issue
